description: This file defines the `SystemUIModes` activity in an Android application, demonstrating various system UI visibility modes, such as fullscreen, immersive, and translucent status/navigation bars. It includes nested classes, UI controls, and methods to manipulate and reflect changes in the system UI state.

classes.name: IV
classes.description: A custom ImageView subclass implementing system UI visibility change listener and action mode handling, used within the `SystemUIModes` activity to demonstrate UI mode changes and user interactions.

classes.name: SystemUIModes
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating and controlling various Android system UI visibility modes and settings, including immersive, fullscreen, and translucent modes. Provides UI controls and logic to manipulate system UI and reflect the current state.

methods.name: setFullscreen
methods.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode by setting or clearing the `FLAG_FULLSCREEN` window flag.

methods.name: setOverscan
methods.description: Enables or disables overscan mode by setting or clearing the `FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_OVERSCAN` window flag.

methods.name: setTranslucentStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent status bar by toggling the `FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS` flag.

methods.name: setTranslucentNavigation
methods.description: Enables or disables translucent navigation bar via the `FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_NAVIGATION` flag.

methods.name: getDisplaySize
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the device display size in pixels.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns a string representing the size and position of the image view within the layout.

methods.name: refreshSizes
methods.description: Updates the display metrics and view size information displayed on the UI.

methods.name: updateCheckControls
methods.description: Synchronizes checkboxes' checked state with current UI visibility flags.

methods.name: updateSystemUi
methods.description: Sets the system UI visibility flags based on user input from checkboxes.

methods.name: clearActionMode
methods.description: Resets the action mode checkbox to unchecked state.
